description: Needs the phone link: the person signs in with the 6-digit code from the Kitchen Timer app (⋯ → Link an agent). Change kitchen defaults: the alert used by new timers (sound, volume, vibration, rings, saying the timer's name), the theme, the screen wake lock, and the Android background keep-alive. Takes effect on the phone the next time the app is opened.

defaultAlert.description: Stamped onto newly created timers and presets. Existing timers keep their own alert.

rings.description: How many times the finish alarm repeats before giving up.

sound.description: The alarm sound. 'off' means vibrate and notification only.

speak.description: Say the timer's name between rings, while the app is open.

volume.description: In-app alarm volume in percent, for when the app is open (never below 10).

keepAlive.description: Play a silent audio loop so Android does not freeze the app in the background. Costs a media notification and some battery.

theme.description: The app's look: auto follows the phone.

wakeLock.description: Keep the phone screen awake while a timer runs and the app is in front.

name: update_settings

appliesWhen.description: When the phone will pick this up.

delivery.description: How recently the phone checked in, so you never imply it has seen this.

lastSyncAgo.description: Last sync in words, e.g. '2m ago'.

notified.description: A push about this change went out.

settings.description: The kitchen defaults after this change.

warnings.description: Things worth saying out loud that are not failures.

title: Update kitchen defaults
